title: Private Dallas and JFK Tour with Local Guide
includes: Live commentary on board by a professional, local guide
Complimentary transportation to and from most Dallas Hotels
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Accessibility Notice Please note that Fun Texas Tours vans are not wheelchair accessible.
Texas law mandates that children under 8 years old, unless they are taller than 4 ft 9 in, must be secured in an appropriate Child Passenger Safety seat or booster seat..
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb: Explore Dallas like never before in 3-hours. If you can’t join a tour group due to your schedule, or you would like to have an exclusive one-on-one private tour with a local, professional guide, this is the best option available. Your guide will create a one-of-a-kind custom tour, just for you. After, you'll discuss in detail what your interests are, and share your favorite landmarks and city sites you would like to visit most.
